claim: Every closed rectifiable arclength-weighted spherical two-design curve on the unit two-sphere has length at least 2*pi*sqrt((1971-180*sqrt(47))/363), numerically 8.9527209263, strictly greater than 2*pi*sqrt(2).
integrity: The claim follows from a self-contained Fourier and covariance argument. The supplemental standard-library numerical checker is non-exhaustive and cannot replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Lower bound not claimed optimal; no classification of minimizers; covers only exact two-design curves with normalized arclength weighting. Historical priority review is provisional.
title: A uniform spectral gap for spherical two-design curves on the two-sphere
